ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  When attempting to use right click tools to run a report there
   is a pop up error and the report does not run.
   
   The attempt results in a popup message with follow contents:
   "DPR-ERR-2079 Firewall
   Security Rejection. Your request was rejected by the security
   firewall.
   "
   
   ITNM Version:  4.2
   Build Level:     Tested on FP2, FP3
   Operating System:  Linux
   Database and Version:   DB2 10.5
   
   Component (if known):    ITNM Reports
   
   APAR being requested:  Yes
   Discussed with SME:      n/a
   
   List of Test Fixes:
   
   
   
   Replicated locally?:     yes
   
   
   Replication steps:
   1)Login to GUI
   2)Open reporting, itnm reports, performance report,
   snmpinbandwidth
   3) Set options, choose a device (remember this device)
   4)Run report and it is successful
   5)Go to HopView or Network Views, find same device as in step 3
   6)Right click the device and choose run report - snmpinbandwidth
   7)Observe error "DPR-ERR-2079 Firewall
   Security Rejection. Your request was rejected by the security
   firewall"

Summary of the Enhancements included in this Fix Pack:
1. Includes integrated Geographic Discovery and Mapping solution
2. Reintroduction of Network Views background image capability

Before installing or upgrading Network Manager, refer to the Fix Pack Release notes:
http://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSSHRK_4.2.0/itnm/ip/wip/relnotes/reference/nmip_rn.html [http://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSSHRK_4.2.0/itnm/ip/wip/relnotes/reference/nmip_rn.html]

IBM Rational Build Forge Fix Pack 3 for Version 7.1.1 (7.1.1.3) - United States

4025288; FixListDocument; fixpack; fix pack; fp03; fp3; fixpack3; 7.1.1.3; Fix Lists; FixLists DOWNLOADABLE FILES

ABSTRACT
 This document describes how to download and install this fix pack to IBM Rational Build Forge Version 7.1.1.3 

DOWNLOAD DESCRIPTION
This Fix Pack contains a set of fixes for the Build Forge 7.1.1 product. 

If you are installing this version as your first installation of Build Forge, see the Prerequisites. 

IMPORTANT ADVISORY: If you are using Rational Automation Framework for WebSphere (RAFW) in conjunction with Rational Build Forge or are planning a full installation, you must use the non-architecture specific full-install files to upgrade.

The following feature was added for this fix pack:


 1. Terminate Threads is a new system configuration setting. It determines what happens when a threaded step fails. If set to Yes, then if a thread fails, all other running threads are terminated, unless the step is set to continue on fail. The default is No which preserves previous behavior.

USING INTERFACE FILTERS WITH-IN A POLL DEFINITION ON LARGE DOMAINS. IV82708 POLLER HAS NO NATIVE METHOD TO REVEAL STATUS OF INTERFACE MONITORS (SNMP BASED) OF LAST POLLED TIME OR LAST POLL FAI IV83320 INCORRECT LAYER2 CONNECTIONS WHEN ROUTER INTERFACES FALL UNDER LARGE SUBNETS (E.G. SUBNET MASK /24) IV84049 NCP_MODEL SHOULD RETAIN THE COLLECTION MEMBERSHIP OF LINGERING DEVICES IV84257 NETWORK ENTITY ICONS DO NOT DISPLAY CUSTOM SEVERITY COLOURS IV84275 INTRODUCE ENV DELAY WITH START OF WAS AFTER STOP DURING INSTALLATION. IV84640 ITNM GATEWAYS CAUSING OS PROFILING TO BE HIGH IV85019 COLLECTION ENTITIES SHOULD BE DELETED WHEN THEY ARE NO LONGER DISCOVERED AND DO NOT CONTAIN ANY LINGERING DEVICES. IV85108 MINOR ERROR WHEN RUNNING DOMAIN_DROP.PL WITH -SCHEMA IV85119 HOPVIEW DOES NOT SHOW LINK THICKNESS IV85878 JAVA MTOSI COLLECTOR FAILS TO COMPLETE DISCOVERY OF HUAWEI U2000 IPCORE IPRAN EMS

ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  When attempting to use right click tools to run a report there
   is a pop up error and the report does not run.
   
   The attempt results in a popup message with follow contents:
   "DPR-ERR-2079 Firewall
   Security Rejection. Your request was rejected by the security
   firewall.
   "
   
   ITNM Version:  4.2
   Build Level:     Tested on FP2, FP3
   Operating System:  Linux
   Database and Version:   DB2 10.5
   
   Component (if known):    ITNM Reports
   
   APAR being requested:  Yes
   Discussed with SME:      n/a
   
   List of Test Fixes:
   
   
   
   Replicated locally?:     yes
   
   
   Replication steps:
   1)Login to GUI
   2)Open reporting, itnm reports, performance report,
   snmpinbandwidth
   3) Set options, choose a device (remember this device)
   4)Run report and it is successful
   5)Go to HopView or Network Views, find same device as in step 3
   6)Right click the device and choose run report - snmpinbandwidth
   7)Observe error "DPR-ERR-2079 Firewall
   Security Rejection. Your request was rejected by the security
   firewall"

1. Includes integrated Geographic Discovery and Mapping solution

 This document describes how to download and install this fix pack to IBM Rational Build Forge Version 7.1.1.3 

DOWNLOAD DESCRIPTION
This Fix Pack contains a set of fixes for the Build Forge 7.1.1 product. 

If you are installing this version as your first installation of Build Forge, see the Prerequisites. 

IMPORTANT ADVISORY: If you are using Rational Automation Framework for WebSphere (RAFW) in conjunction with Rational Build Forge or are planning a full installation, you must use the non-architecture specific full-install files to upgrade.

The following feature was added for this fix pack:
